column4: Borrows from beyond top bit then discards
Shift by 31 fills all sign bits (all ones)
Shift amount uses only lower 5 bits (shamt=32 wraps to 0)
Shift all ones left by 1 drops MSB
All ones logical right shift inserts 0 at MSB
Zero XOR all ones --> all ones
All ones XOR zero --> all ones
Zero OR all ones --> all ones
All ones OR all ones --> all ones
MSB and lower bits combined = all ones
All ones AND all ones = all ones
